ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (35) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form); blocks 17 had no website counterpart and were translated fresh.

Gospel verses are translated from Tolstoy's Russian, with lowercase «отец» (otets, 'father') and pronouns for God as in the source; «отрешиться» (otreshit'sya, 'detach oneself') is repeated as in Epictetus's text. Reading 5 and its attribution «Амиел» (Amiel, 'Amiel', printed without the soft sign) stand outside the quotation format, as printed; both oddities are flagged.
Source observation: [14] The reference is printed «cm. 23» with Latin letters c, m for Cyrillic «ст.» ('verse'); translated as John 16:23.
Source observation: [17] Reading 5 and its attribution are printed as ordinary text, not as a quotation, and the name is spelled «Амиел» rather than the usual «Амиель»; translated as printed (Amiel).
